title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
provenance: Reproduced by the maintainer with the free Prologue Demo (Steam 3130330) on an M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.7, 2026-09-12; first reported on the full game by Napo2k (highball#80, M5 Max, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.8.8, engine r0). CrossOver 24 and 26 users show the game running on Apple Silicon. Not playable on Highball yet.
notes: DirectX 11, Denuvo on the full game. Measured with the demo: on the Wine 10 engine (Sikarugir, r0 to r2) the game faults seconds after launch, before any window, reading address 0x20FF in its own code. Wine's relay trace shows the thread creating fibers and switching to one right before the fault: on macOS the fiber pointer a game reads with GetCurrentFiber() comes from the host thread block, where that slot holds the thread's QoS class, not the fiber. The same crash with AVX advertised and on DXVK instead of DXMT, so neither the CPU feature nor the graphics layer is involved. On the Wine 11 engine (r5 to r7), which mirrors the fiber pointer into that slot, the game reaches its window, then the process hangs at full CPU with a black window: the mirrored fiber pointer sits in the slot macOS's dispatch library reads as a QoS class, and its main thread faults inside that library. The fix is in the engine (an r8 that keeps the fiber pointer for the game and the QoS class for macOS), not in a setting. Until then the game does not play on Highball.

knownIssues.symptom: Wine 10 engine: page fault reading 0x20FF in the game's own code seconds after launch, no window
knownIssues.cause: measured: the game's fiber pointer on macOS reads back as the thread's QoS class; the game hands it to SwitchToFiber
knownIssues.fix: engine work (r8); no setting changes it

knownIssues.symptom: Wine 11 engine (r5 to r7): the window opens black and the process hangs at full CPU
knownIssues.cause: measured: the engine's fiber mirror occupies the QoS slot macOS's dispatch library reads on the main thread, which then faults
